parsed.post: New personal best! 0.9805 -> 0.9694 with DEPTH=8 and current settings. It seems the convergence is very healthy. I'll now try lowering the learning rate to 0.05 to see if we can reach a deeper local minimum, following the trend of lower LRs benefiting the depth 8 configuration.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to test if more conservative updates improve convergence further, following the team's observed trend for DEPTH=8.
